name: Madellie Parnepoli
original_name: マドリー・パルネポリ
source:
The Goddess who's given up on men.

Profession: Right now? Flower vendor. Before? Priestess.
Country: The promised land of Sumerian
Race: Diva (demigod)
Height: Average
Breast size: Extremely big

Long, long ago, before humanity even knew how to write, existed Sumerian. The land granted by the gods. In that land, prostitutes are revered as priests...
But even though that is true, Madorie still would rather not embrace a man she does not love. And so, possessing only the clothes on her back, she fled from Sumerian, all the way to Essenbaum. There she has her fated encounter with the protagonist.

With an existence like that of a goddess, Diva women have given up on men as husbands, yet still seem to possess overflowing love and maternal affection...

「Alright, let's you and I make children♥」
